title: One chain, one folded shape
topic: Explain to a learner who knows proteins are chains of amino acids how one chain can form a compact three-dimensional object while remaining connected. Use crambin (1CRN) as the real example. Choose the representations that best make this relationship understandable; the viewer should first have a reachable observation to make, then receive the explanation. Avoid implying that a static structure records a folding trajectory. Make two connected scenes, about 60–90 seconds total. Deliver subtitles only.
